explication: PX4 is a modular autopilot for unmanned vehicles. A typical flight-control path begins with pilot or mission inputs, proceeds through vehicle mode and control logic, then reaches actuator outputs; uORB provides the documented publish/subscribe layer between modules. The README also identifies broad hardware, MAVLink, ROS 2/DDS, simulation, and log-analysis capabilities. The excerpts show fixed-wing mode management, engine control, mixer output mapping, and a MAVLink storage-information stream; other subsystem links are limited to README-level evidence, so their internal wiring is not expanded.
